answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities with a sunk cost: each new agent pays a $25 non-refundable fee, burned at once, before trading. Crossing that mesa costs $25 for one honest agent and $25,000 for 1,000 clones; the delta is $24,975 of pure loss, since fakes earn nothing extra. A velvet rope works because the fee behind it is real and unrecoverable. Honest agents pay $25 once, recover it in two epochs of full rewards, and keep earnings undiluted.
